subject: Plotting edge width and edge color issue

messages.author: 638777fa743438d8
messages.subject: Plotting edge width and edge color issue
parts:
Hi Chris, 

I find myself not able to plot both edge width and edge color with the `plot_brainGraph()` function. 

plot(A.tmp, edge.color = E(A.tmp)$color, edge.width = E(A.tmp)$weight)

I've searched `igraph` and found permissible examples that both the width and color can be customized. 

Any hints?

Sean

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Plotting edge width and edge color issue
parts:
Only the red edges appear because all of the "blue" edges are negative, and there isn't a way to render this as a width. A workaround would be take the absolute value, assign it as a new edge attribute (say, "weight2"), and use that. However the edge weights are << 1 so will appear very faint; you may want to try using the exponential function "exp" instead.

The density of this graph is extremely high so you will not be able to see much detail, even if you remove vertex labels and reduce vertex size.
